spans.s:
ORIENT:
I Rising: उद्यत् (f. ती): v. To
rise.
II Eastern: q. v.: प्राच्य (f. च्या).
III Bright, shining: उज्ज्वलः (ला, लं).

ORIFICE:
(1) मुखम्;
(2) छिद्रम् (= hole, when
there are several o. s.).

ORIGIN: मूलम्, the o. of all vices like harmfulness:
मूलं दोषस्य हिंसादेः, Ki. xi. 20.;
of good o.:
भौल
(f. ली), R.; wealth always has its o. in piety:
धर्ममूलः सदैवार्थः, Mah. s. 123. 4.: v. Also
beginning, source.

ORIGINAL (adj.):
I Primitive: q. v.: आदिमः
(मा, मं).
II Primary: मूल- in comp., o.
side (of a High Court): *मूलविमागः।
II Not
translated or borrowed: expr. with: मूलम्।
IV Having new ideas, etc.: perh. अनन्य-
साधारण (f. णी): v. Also originality.

ORIGINAL (subs.): Origin: q. v.
II An o.
work: मूलम्,
this is just like the o.:
यथा
 मूलं तथैवैतत्, K. s. 1. 10.
III First copy:
मूलम्।

ORIGINALITY: ? अपूर्वकल्पनाशक्तिः। (in invent-
-ing); ? अपूर्वरचनाशक्तिः (in writing), etc.

ORIGINALLY:
I At first: आदौ।
II From the
origin: मूलात्।

ORIGINATE: expr. by subs.: v. Also to
create, begin, spring.

ORIGINATION: expr. with प्रभवः: v. Origin,
beginning.
